Settings How CubeLab works Source on GitHub

Design preview. Timer: press Timer, or hold Space and let go. Press again to stop; press Timer again, click the time or press Esc to hide it. Drag a face to turn a layer. Drag empty space to turn the whole cube; it settles upright with one face on top. Double-click to reset the view. Keys R U F L D B turn faces in the starting orientation, add Shift for a prime turn. For now Solve replays your moves in reverse; the real solver arrives in Sprint 2.
